bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for interchange improvements at marked Trunk Highway 65 and Bunker Lake Boulevard Northeast in the city of Ham Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ANOKA COUNTY AND CITY OF HAM LAKE; MARKED TRUNK HIGHWAY 65. +]

[+$16,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation for preliminary engineering, environmental documentation, final design, right-of-way acquisition, and construction of intersection improvements along marked Trunk Highway 65 at Anoka County State-Aid Highway 116, also known as Bunker Lake Boulevard Northeast, and associated frontage roads and backage roads within the trunk highway system. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2031. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for interchange improvements at marked Trunk Highway 65 and Bunker Lake Boulevard Northeast in the city of Ham Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ANOKA COUNTY AND CITY OF HAM LAKE; MARKED TRUNK HIGHWAY 65.

$16,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation for preliminary engineering, environmental documentation, final design, right-of-way acquisition, and construction of intersection improvements along marked Trunk Highway 65 at Anoka County State-Aid Highway 116, also known as Bunker Lake Boulevard Northeast, and associated frontage roads and backage roads within the trunk highway system. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2031.
